text:
amal: Heads-up — release train tomorrow 09:00–13:00 PT. Need owners for lanes A/B/C and a smoke for each. Current roster shows a gap for lane B from 10:30–11:00. Who can cover? Also flag any DB migrations or infra work.

ryan: I can take lane B 10:30–11:00. Will be on the slot and available for rollback. Tagging here so sched board updates.

sophia: I can pair with @ryan for rollback readiness and smoke validation. I'll add the smoke checklist to the train card.

deploy-bot: slot reserved — lane B 10:30–11:00 by @ryan (ID: slot-9876). Reminder: claim in the release board and drop your brief runbook.

mike: quick heads-up — there's a DB migration in PR #2345. It's non-destructive but takes ~3–4 mins on canary. Do we want infra to run it during the lane B slot before traffic?

amal: good catch @mike. Plan: run migration in canary first (lane A canary at 09:15). If green, run in lane B pre-deploy at 10:20. We'll need infra on standby.

sophia: pinging infra-ops for migration window @infra-ops — can you confirm availability 10:15–10:40?

jessica: infra-ops here — we can run the migration and monitor. I'll be on-call 10:00–11:15 and will keep the rollback script ready.

ryan: I'll run the smoke tests post-deploy. Smoke checklist (short):
```
1) /health -> 200 on app host
2) sample gen latency < 250ms (p95)
3) core endpoints: /v1/generate, /v1/embeddings -> sanity responses
4) metrics: token-rate within expected range
```

ryan: I'll also leave the quick rollback commands in the slot card: `deploy rollback --to last-stable` and `k rollback deployment/redwood-runtime --revision N`.

amal: Rollback owners: @mike for app rollback, @jessica for DB rollback. If either owner is unavailable, escalate to @sophia.

sophia: noted — will take escalation for both if needed. Added short runbook link: https://go/release-train/runbooks/smoke-lane.md :thumbsup:

mike: I'll do the app rollback prep and watch the canary logs. Will try to review PR #2345 tonight so infra only needs to run it.

amal: One more ask — small code-review ping: PR #2350 needs a quick +1 (stateless change). If someone can eyeball it before 08:30 PT tomorrow, we can avoid blocking the deploy.

mike: I can review at 20:00 PT and should be done in ~20 mins.

ryan: I'll update the release board, mark lane B claimed, and add the smoke checklist link.

amal: Thanks all. Summary: lane B covered by @ryan (10:30–11:00), infra @jessica will run migration 10:20 canary->lane B, rollback owners assigned (@mike app, @jessica db), smoke checklist in slot card. If anything changes, update thread or the release board. :rocket:
